bagPolicy.summary: Bags may measure up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches. Non-clear bags get extra screening.
allowed: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Use nearby garages or street parking. There is no attached garage. Follow posted restrictions.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Aztec Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Bars are cashless. Pay by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. Ask Guest Services for cash-to-card help.
